author: Lankastria
body: I was banned for advertising play.mcbestcraft.net. This server is currently inactive so I advertised as  a joke. I was banned by Jiveh. I was unaware that advertising caused a ban

replies.author: Lankastria
replies.body: Very sorry, it wouldn't happen again.

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello Lankastria,

Regardless of whether the server is inactive or active you are still advertising which means you are still breaking the rules. This appeal is denied. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
